Predicates:
OlympicGames(x) ::: x is a summer Olympic games.
LastSummerOlympics(x) ::: x is the last summer Olympic games.
Location(x, y) ::: x took place in y.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in y.
Premises:
OlympicGames(summerOlympics) ::: The summer Olympic games is a sporting event.
LastSummerOlympics(tokyoOlympics) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
Location(tokyoOlympics, tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
WonMostMedals(unitedStates, tokyoOlympics) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
WonMostMedals(unitedStates, tokyoOlympics) ::: The United States won the most medals in the last summer Olympic games.
